## Astronomical 0.2.102
### New - **Export a chat.** Save a whole chat, one answer, or the messages you pick as a PDF, a Word document or a web page. The export sheet previews the pages and remembers your choices. Tables, formulas, code, checklists, pictures and diagrams carry over, and nothing in the file loads from the network. - **Exports fit your paper.** The preview, the PDF and the Word document follow the Mac's paper size (A4 or Letter). Text prints at the sizes shown, a heading stays with what it introduces, short lists stay whole, and a diagram is sized to fit its page. - **Clef decision models** are recognised in the Library and run as a text-only backend.
### Improved - A chat that fails says what went wrong in plain words and what to try next, including when the Mac ran out of graphics memory. - While a model is still loading, the chat says it is loading the model. - Code blocks have a Copy button, and a generated picture can be saved or copied. - Checklists in answers are drawn as checklists. - Every model is shown under one name, its model ID. - The Neural Engine preparation banner appears only for waits long enough to matter.
### Fixed - A fresh install starts with Neural Engine prefill off. - Stopping an instance also sees an agent that macOS started at login.
### Compatibility - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - Settings, chats, downloaded models and the Library are preserved. No configuration field was removed. - The app is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed update feed.
